title: 1D Wave Equation - Leapfrog (FDM)
desc.intro: We solve the 1D wave equation with fixed ends (u = 0 at the boundaries) and configurable initial conditions. For the sinusoidal initial condition, the known analytical solution is used for comparison during the animation.
desc.method: We use the explicit leapfrog scheme on a uniform grid; stability is controlled by the CFL number (dt = CFL·dx/c). The frames are rendered and combined into a GIF for viewing in the browser.
